topic: the yubiOS RSI regime playbook (yubi-OS/yubiOS playbooks/rsi-regime.md)

subtopics.scope: What the RSI regime is: a family of skills, scripts and render pipelines that audits, gap-maps and improves any corpus through a bounded recursive loop, with the parameter t on the Riemann sphere S2 rather than a flat [0,1] line.
seed_queries: recursive self improvement bounded loop corpus audit agent
manifold aware parameterization Riemann sphere data embedding

subtopics.scope: The 9 skills of the regime and their roles: recursive-self-improvement, rsi-phi-skill, hyperspherical-harmonic-curve, learned-latent-curve, single-action-curve-rsi, curve-guided-rsi, curve-guided-rsi-self, negative-skill-space, parallel-deep-research.

The 5-step per-cycle loop: gap-map via negative-skill-space, ONE hypothesis from a fresh subagent at t=i/N, human-approved edit, re-map with PCA top-2 plus stereographic lift and a real SH gamma(t) fit, fixpoint rule.
seed_queries: stereographic projection sphere embedding point cloud
spherical harmonics curve fitting least squares fit

subtopics.scope: The 7 hard rules whose silent substitution voids the audit trail: canonical Fibonacci indexing, Condon-Shortley normalization of Y_3^3, both (l=128,m=256) and (l=256,m=128) orderings tested, i=t, no latitude-longitude substitution, fresh-context subagent per cycle in self-mode, doubt-driven-development as supplement only.
seed_queries: Vogel golden angle spiral point distribution sphere
Saff Kuijlaars Fibonacci lattice equal area 1997

subtopics.scope: The math conventions frozen across the regime: PCA top-2 to stereographic lift from the south pole, identity-init Mobius with 6 real DOF, chordal S2 residuals, real SH basis L=3 to 16 functions, closed-form ridge with lambda=1e-3, t from PC1 min-max scaled, frozen degree weights, PC1+PC2 fit gate 0.40.
seed_queries: Condon Shortley phase spherical harmonic normalization
ridge regression closed form normal equations lambda

subtopics.scope: The 5-dim time-series library at papers/data/series/INDEX.json: 7-D repo-refs basis, 9-D internal-big-picture basis, 16-D real SH basis, 24-D composite basis, 384-D Fibonacci-sphere phi basis, each with its PC1+PC2 gate outcome.
seed_queries: multi dimensional corpus coverage basis fit gate

subtopics.scope: The render output directories and their consumers: curve-map-output, nd-viewer-output, curve-map-output-384d, curve-map-output-multi-corpus, drift-output, per-dim fit.png graphs, and the keystone and overlay PNGs.
seed_queries: mollweide aitoff projection data scatter render

subtopics.scope: The selection table (1-D corpus to recursive-self-improvement, sphere-shaped corpus to rsi-phi-skill, single file to single-action-curve-rsi, self-mode to curve-guided-rsi-self, sweep-only to negative-skill-space) and the 3-cycle default cap with explicit user override.

when to use recursive improvement variants
